name: Kansas Furcon
description: Kansas Furcon is a proposed family-friendly furry convention in Great Bend, Kansas, organized by Furry Fansago. It is planned to feature games, music, art, vendors and a group photo on the third night, with three-day tickets priced at $25 for adults and $12 for children ages 5 to 17. The first event has been postponed until at least 2025, with the location and date to be decided.
